# MUCO Labs

> Custom software, AI chatbots, web apps and automation built from Erode, Tamil Nadu, India.

## About
MUCO Labs is a founder-built software agency based in Erode. Founder: Srinivash Mahalingam. Builds with AI-assisted tooling plus hands-on code.

## Services
- AI Chatbots & Assistants: 24/7 support bots, RAG, lead qualification.
- Custom Web Apps: dashboards, portals, internal tools.
- Automation: connect tools, kill repetitive work.
- Websites & SEO: fast, mobile-first, rankable.
- Mobile Apps: cross-platform.
- Consulting: problem mapping and stack selection.
